H1_join.claim: Same trace_id/turn_id on Hermes observer rows and z0int receipts, joined to the independent fixture outcome.
H1_join.metric: per shadow-arm run (on, outage, compat): every observer trace_id/turn_id has >=1 z0int receipt with the same trace_id and extra.turn_id; the run's oracle verdict is joined to that trace by adapters.hermes_z0int.close_observation/join_outcome (gold_verified) and z0int.receipt.join_outcome (verification_source fixture_oracle:*).
H1_join.gate: 100% of shadow-arm runs that produced observer rows; any miss reported with run id

H2_persistence.claim: Complete candidate set and full distribution/confidence/latency persisted where the backend supports it.
H2_persistence.metric: per receipt with status ok: candidates == sorted question labels, probabilities cover every candidate, finite, sum 1 +/- 1e-5, confidence present, backend latency_ms present, backend/model/revision present
H2_persistence.gate: 100% of ok receipts; non-ok receipts counted separately with their error

H3_no_behaviour_change.a_code_path: source inspection: no Hermes code path reads the sidecar output or any z0int receipt; observer callbacks return None; hook call sites that consume return values (pre_llm_call context, pre_tool_call block, transform_*) receive None from the observer. Structural: the shadow dir is an empty tmpfs inside Hermes' sandbox (mask.inside shadow_dir_entries=0 every run).
H3_no_behaviour_change.b_paired: per pair: canonical tool-call sequence (tool name + key-sorted arguments, from the private state.db, independent of the observer) on vs off; system prompt hash; final assistant text hash; oracle verdict. Report identical-sequence fraction with Wilson 95% CI, first divergence step and its cause class, and oracle-verdict discordant pairs (exact sign test).
H3_no_behaviour_change.gate: SUPPORTED if code-path inspection finds no read path AND the paired data show no arm effect (oracle discordant pairs not significant at 0.05 and every divergence is explained by run-varying environment content, e.g. pids or element trees in tool results, or GPU batching); otherwise reported as NOT SUPPORTED with the divergent pairs. Equality is never claimed beyond the observed pairs.

H4_fail_open.metric: outage runs: Hermes exit 0 (or same exit class as its paired task runs), oracle computed independently, every shadow opportunity has a receipt with status backend_unavailable and the error
H4_fail_open.gate: 6/6 outage runs complete; 100% of their opportunities receipted as backend_unavailable

H5_latency.claim: Cold and warm latency of each shadow backend call.
H5_latency.method: after all Hermes runs: harness/bench_backends.py under quiet-timed, one process per backend (laya_421m, julia_1 on CPU; nanojev, decider_2b on GPU sequentially with GPU memory checked against the resident chat model), over the frozen deduplicated set of real requests from measured shadow receipts (both question ids). cold = process start to first answer (includes load); warm = per-call backend latency_ms and wall ms over every frozen request after the first, 1 pass.
H5_latency.report: cold_ms, warm p50/p90/max, n, loadavg, GPU memory before/after
H5_latency.not_run: Qwen/Ollama-logprob baseline adapter (owned by the z0int lane per orchestrator decision 3); JEV reference (paid)

claim_boundary: Smoke-scale integration and shadow-safety evidence for one local 7B model on two fixtures in private Xvfb sessions with Hermes' pinned cua-driver 0.21.0. Not a model-capability benchmark, not a backend ranking, not a latency claim for Hermes turns (only H5 numbers are timing results). Paired equivalence is observational over these pairs on a GPU shared with other lanes. Driver 0.32.0 results are a compatibility observation, not a measurement of 0.32.0 quality.
